title: Quiz: LangChain Tutorial: From Prompts to RAG and AI Agents
description: Check your grasp of LangChain in Python, from chat messages and prompt templates to LCEL chains, RAG retrieval, and tool-calling agents.
summary: In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of LangChain Tutorial: From Prompts to RAG and AI Agents . You’ll revisit how to steer a chat model with system and human messages, build reusable prompt templates, and chain steps together with the LangChain Expression Language (LCEL).
takeaways: You’ll revisit how to steer a chat model with system and human messages, build reusable prompt templates, and chain steps together with the LangChain Expression Language (LCEL).
You’ll also review how RAG grounds answers in your own data and how a tool-calling agent decides which functions to run.
